steps.name: three-queued-then-one-ready
steps.detail: atm task list --json (as fx-at10-beta) after assigning at10-c1-1790200708-{1,2,3} to beta: positions 1,2,3 all state 'assigned'. atm task events at10-c1-1790200708-1 --json showed handoffs [{"kind":"task_queued"},{"kind":"task_ready","trigger":"task_pass"}]; tasks -2 and -3 events showed only {"kind":"task_queued"} (no task_ready) -- exactly one ready task. atm list --pending-ack --json (as beta) run after each of the three assignments all returned {"count":0,"rows":[],"bucket_counts":{"unread":N,"pending_ack":0,...}} with pending_ack:0 in all three runs (unread climbing 1,2,3).

steps.name: close-releases-next
steps.detail: atm task start at10-c1-1790200708-1 then atm task close at10-c1-1790200708-1 completed (as beta) both returned {"outcome":"sent",...}. Polling atm task events at10-c1-1790200708-2 --json at 1s/30s bound found handoffs [{"kind":"task_queued"},{"kind":"task_ready","at":"2026-09-23T21:58:40.689051720Z","trigger":"task_pass"}] and events[] entry {"event":"reminded","outcome":"emitted"}; atm task list --json (beta) then showed at10-c1-1790200708-2 at position 1 with reminder_count:1 -- next task became ready within the bounded poll.

steps.name: reassign-notifies-both
steps.detail: As alpha: atm task assign fx-at10-gamma "reassigning task three" --task-id at10-c1-1790200708-3 --json returned {"task_id":"at10-c1-1790200708-3"}. atm task events at10-c1-1790200708-3 --json then showed events[] entry {"event":"reassigned","assignee":"fx-at10-gamma","from_state":"assigned","to_state":"assigned"} and handoffs [{"agent":"fx-at10-beta","kind":"task_closed"},{"agent":"fx-at10-gamma","kind":"task_queued"}]. atm read --message-id 01M384FS6AKQX3BSWBWTGWTQMW --json (as beta) showed {"text":"task at10-c1-1790200708-3 was reassigned to fx-at10-gamma","summary":"task_closed:at10-c1-1790200708-3"}. atm task list --json (gamma) showed the task assigned/queued to gamma.

steps.name: move-head-readies-once
steps.detail: Assigned at10-c4-1790200788-A then -B to idle beta. Polled A's events until task_ready appeared (handoffs: task_queued, task_ready). Then atm task move at10-c4-1790200788-B --head --json (as alpha) returned {"from":2,"to":1}. atm task events at10-c4-1790200788-A --json still showed exactly one {"kind":"task_ready"} handoff (unchanged from before the move). atm task events at10-c4-1790200788-B --json showed events[] {"event":"moved","detail":"2\u21921"} followed by exactly one handoffs {"kind":"task_ready","trigger":"task_pass"} -- no duplicate ready event on either task.

steps.name: cancel-notifies-assignee
steps.detail: As alpha: atm task assign fx-at10-beta "case5 cancel me" --task-id at10-c5-1790200808 --json then immediately atm task close at10-c5-1790200808 cancelled "cancelling before start" --json returned {"outcome":"sent",...}. atm task events at10-c5-1790200808 --json (as beta) showed events[] {"event":"cancelled","close_outcome":"cancelled","to_state":"complete"} while task_ready never appeared (handoffs only task_queued then task_closed). atm read --message-id 01M384H156EQ36S0GH897Z4KGC --json (as beta) showed {"taskOp":{"op":"close","outcome":"cancelled","reason":"cancelling before start"}} delivered to beta.

steps.name: busy-assigner-sees-terminal-lines
steps.detail: Assigned at10-c6-1790200830-D to alpha (as gamma); atm task start at10-c6-1790200830-D (as alpha) then atm task list --json (as alpha) showed [{"task_id":"at10-c6-1790200830-D","state":"active",...}] -- quoted 'active' before beta's task ran. As alpha, assigned at10-c6-1790200830-E to beta; beta ran atm task start then atm task close ... completed. atm list --unread --json (as alpha) then contained both rows in chronological order: {"summary":"beta starting E","timestamp":"2026-09-23T22:00:37.344501704Z"} followed by {"summary":"beta completed E","timestamp":"2026-09-23T22:00:37.357801756Z"}, and atm task events at10-c6-1790200830-E --json (as alpha) showed events[] in order {"event":"started","to_state":"active"} then {"event":"completed","close_outcome":"completed","to_state":"complete"}, with D's task list entry unaffected and still active throughout.

steps.name: cleanup
steps.detail: Closed every task created during the run with atm task close (all --json {"outcome":"sent"}): at10-c1-1790200708-1 completed, -2 completed, -3 (reassigned then closed by gamma) completed, at10-c4-1790200788-B completed, -A completed, at10-c5-1790200808 was closed via its own cancellation, at10-c6-1790200830-E completed, -D completed. Final atm task list --json for fx-at10-alpha, fx-at10-beta, fx-at10-gamma all returned [] confirming empty queues.
